metadata.description: How Claude Code works as a loop — plan, gate, execute, verify — told through two real bugs from this toolkit's own 9:16 build: a portrait composer a plan wrongly called portrait-ready (caught by a standalone render), and a Manim coordinate-frame bug that passed its layout audit while underfilling the frame.

Here's the problem. Claude writes the code for a video faster than I can. It can't watch the video.
So the work runs as a loop. Plan: nothing is built until I approve it. Gate: I sign the narration be

Here's the fix. Type size was never the problem; position was. The old layout stacked everything bet

Example two is worse, because the check passed. The vertical Manim scenes cleared the layout audit w
Here's what was happening. A portrait resolution doesn't change Manim's coordinate frame. The scenes
Before, the scenes used roughly the center quarter of the canvas. After, they span the full frame, a
So that's the loop. Plan, approved first. Gate, signed by a person. Execute, where Claude is fastest
